caption: The drawing depicts a single red metal coffee pot with a tall, conical body, a curved spout on the left side, and a large, rounded handle on the right side. The pot is decorated with floral and circular designs in shades of brown, gold, white, and black, primarily on the central area and lower part, with some accent patterns near the lid and base. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color with no additional objects or details, and the pot casts no visible shadow, appearing centered and upright. The artist’s signature appears in small red text near the bottom right of the pot.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
